summary: Deck published successfully (519 KB PDF, 24 slides) but visual rendering reveals critical gaps for the Language programme. The CONTENT is high quality — title slides, unit overview, lesson plan slides (3-7), summative rubric (22), certificate (23), and marketplace listing (24) all render cleanly with correct text and structure. The CRITICAL ISSUES are: (1) Both character puppet slides (20, 21) show wrong fallback artwork — Sounder Sam appears as random clipart icons (apple, water bottle, T-rex), Blendy appears as a spider web. The stock-clipart fallback that worked acceptably for Math characters fails entirely for owl + bear character types not represented in sample_assets/. (2) All 5 worksheet preview slides (8-12) show generic math/spatial templates ('Sort by Shape', 'Match Units', or empty 'Worksheet area' rectangles) instead of phonics-specific layouts (sound boxes, letter-to-sound match, sentence strips). The existing template_composers were built for math; phonics needs new composers. (3) All 7 manipulative slides (13-19) show empty bordered placeholder areas instead of the actual cards/charts/posters. STATUS: revise_assets. Phase B (SVG character creation) addresses issues 1-2 directly. A new pipeline/template_composers/phonics.py addresses issues 3-15. The 5-day pedagogical content is sound and ready; the visual asset pipeline needs phonics-specific work before scaling to 28 units.
